hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.md) prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; markdownlint "$f";; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.json) prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; jsonlint "$f";; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.sh) shfmt -w "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; shellcheck "$f";; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; ruff check "$f";; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.yaml|*.yml) prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; yamllint "$f";; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.el) out=$(emacsclient --eval "(with-temp-buffer (insert-file-contents \"$f\") (emacs-lisp-mode) (check-parens))" 2>&1); ec=$?; if [ "$ec" -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out"; fi; exit "$ec";; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.lua) stylua "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; (cd "$(dirname "$f")" && luacheck "$(basename "$f")");; esac; }
